title: DIP draft contract v1
description: Setup proposal derived from Sprint 3. No endpoint is implemented. Firestore Timestamp values map to ISO 8601 UTC on JSON boundaries.

workLocation.description: Server-owned (admin tooling, roster, import). Office or site name, empty when unknown.

status.description: Server-owned. Missing means active. deactivated blocks sign-in access and company reads.

revision.description: Server-owned, optional. Incremented by every admin edit; used for optimistic concurrency.

statusUpdatedAt.description: Server-owned, optional. When status last changed.

updatedBy.description: Server-owned: UID of the organizer whose updateEventV1 wrote the current revision.

changeLog.description: Server-owned, optional: latest 50 user-visible changes, oldest first (onEventChanged trigger).

by.description: Editor UID from Event.updatedBy, or "organizer" when the writer is unknown.

source.description: Server-owned, optional: who created the RSVP (missing means self).

managedBy.description: Server-owned, optional: uid of the admin who added or removed the attendee.

status.description: Server-owned. submitted = pending review (also after a resubmission), approved = points awarded, rejected = needs changes (the member may resubmit while the window is open).

storagePath.description: companies/{companyId}/challenges/{challengeId}/submissions/{userId}/{slot} with slot 0..4 (one create-only Storage object per slot), or null for a note-only submission.

contentType.description: Server-owned, optional: verified evidence content type.

sizeBytes.description: Server-owned, optional: verified evidence size in bytes.

attempt.description: Server-owned, optional: 1 for the first submission, +1 for every resubmission after a rejection.

reviewedBy.description: Server-owned: organizer uid of the last review, null while pending.

reviewNote.description: Server-owned: the organizer's reason for a rejection.

pointsAwarded.description: Server-owned: points credited on approval (0 until approved).

storagePath.description: companies/{companyId}/events/{eventId}/photos/{uploaderId}/{slot} with slot 0..19 (one create-only object per slot).

downloadURL.description: Legacy/reference field. finalizeEventPhotoV1 stores an empty string: no bearer download-token URLs are minted; clients read bytes through the authenticated Storage SDK (gcp/storage.rules).

commentCount.description: Server-owned: recounted by the onPhotoCommentCreated trigger.

sizeBytes.description: Server-owned, optional: verified object size in bytes (finalizeEventPhotoV1).

contentType.description: Server-owned, optional: verified object content type (finalizeEventPhotoV1).

status.description: pending | accepted | declined. Written only by sendInviteV1/respondToInviteV1.

requestId.description: Server-kept idempotency key of the sendInviteV1 call that created the invite.

status.description: completed: only a scheduled event that has ended. Leaving completed after the album has photos needs an admin and statusReason.

statusReason.description: Required (admin only) to reopen or cancel a completed event whose album has photos.

checkedIn.description: Optional, default true. false marks a no-show and is refused once points were awarded (ATTENDANCE_LOCKED).

changed.description: False when the stored state already matched (idempotent replay).

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Optional but expected from the portal: the `updatedAt` of the submission as listed. If the member changed the entry since, the command fails SUBMISSION_CHANGED.

replayed.description: true when the submission was already approved: nothing was awarded again (pointsAwarded is 0).

FinalizeEventPhotoRequest.description: finalizeEventPhotoV1: publish an uploaded album photo. photoId must equal '{auth.uid}_{slot}' and storagePath the matching Storage object; retries are idempotent on photoId.

created.description: false when this photoId was already finalized (idempotent retry).

AuditFieldChange.description: Short, redacted string summaries; never secrets, tokens or full documents.

AuditEntry.description: companies/{c}/auditLog/{auditId}. Append-only, written in the same transaction as the command; admin-readable only.

action.description: Dotted verb, for example member.update, photo.remove, attendee.add, import.apply.

EmployeeRecordInput.description: One employee row (roster entry or import row). Omitted optional fields are left unchanged on update and defaulted on create.

email.description: Work email; lower-cased server-side and matched against the company's emailDomain.

displayName.description: Hint shown until first sign-in; Google's name wins afterwards (ADR 0007).

teamIds.description: Team catalog ids or exact team names (resolved server-side).

RosterEntry.description: companies/{c}/roster/{emailHash}. Admin-readable only; server-written. Lists everyone: invited (pre-imported, not signed in yet), claimed (signed in) and revoked entries. resolveMembershipV1 claims an invited entry, or creates a claimed one, on every first join.

id.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the lower-case email.

invitedBy.description: Admin who pre-provisioned the entry; absent for entries created by the person's own sign-in.

memberStatus.description: Mirrors the member's status once claimed; kept in sync by setMemberStatusV1.

resendCount.description: How many times an admin resent the invite message.

revision.description: 0 when the member was never admin-edited.

target.description: update/unchanged target an existing member; create targets a roster entry (no account yet).

ImportJob.description: companies/{c}/importJobs/{jobId}. Admin-readable summary and error-report data; rows and plan chunks are server-only.

RemoveEventPhotoRequest.description: removeEventPhotoV1: hard-deletes the album photo, its comments and Storage object; audit entry. album.moderate.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason recorded in the audit log.

removed.description: False when the photo was already gone.

RemoveEventPhotoCommentRequest.description: removeEventPhotoCommentV1: deletes one comment and recounts commentCount; audit entry. album.moderate.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason recorded in the audit log.

AddEventAttendeeRequest.description: addEventAttendeeV1: RSVP an active same-company member as going. attendee.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

notify.description: Default false: send an in-app notification to the member.

capacityOverrideReason.description: Required to add beyond capacity: raises the event capacity to attendeeCount + 1 and is audited.

added.description: False when the member was already going.

RemoveEventAttendeeRequest.description: removeEventAttendeeV1: cancel a member's RSVP before the event ends. attendee.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason recorded in the audit log.

removed.description: False when the member was not going.

ListMembersRequest.description: listMembersV1: searchable company member directory. member.read (points only for admins).

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of name, email, department, job title or work location.

total.description: Company members in total (first page only), for 'N of M'.

UpdateMemberRequest.description: updateMemberV1: change role, teams and org attributes. member.manage (admin). Cannot demote the last admin; displayName/points/auth ids are not editable here.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

expectedRevision.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency guard; mismatch -> aborted REVISION_CONFLICT. 0 means never admin-edited.

revision.description: Member revision after the call; 0 when the member was never admin-edited.

ResetMemberProfileRequest.description: resetMemberProfileV1: clears self-set profile data (photoURL, avatarId, city, interestTagIds, travelRadiusMiles, availability, favoritePhotoIds). Keeps identity, role, department, jobTitle, teams, location, status, points and friends. member.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason recorded in the audit log.

revision.description: Member revision after the call; 0 when the member was never admin-edited.

SetMemberStatusRequest.description: setMemberStatusV1: deactivate or reactivate. Deactivation revokes refresh tokens, cancels upcoming going RSVPs, and blocks resolveMembershipV1/rules/callables. member.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason recorded in the audit log.

revision.description: Member revision after the call; 0 when the member was never admin-edited.

AdjustMemberPointsRequest.description: adjustMemberPointsV1: appends an admin_adjustment ledger entry and updates pointsBalance atomically. member.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

delta.description: Non-zero; the balance may not become negative.

UpsertTeamRequest.description: upsertTeamV1: create (no teamId) or rename/archive a team in the company catalog. team.manage (admin).

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

UpsertRosterEntryRequest.description: upsertRosterEntryV1: pre-provision one person who has not signed in. roster.manage (admin). An email that already belongs to a member is refused (EMAIL_ALREADY_MEMBER); use updateMemberV1.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

RevokeRosterEntryRequest.description: revokeRosterEntryV1: revoke an invited entry. roster.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

ImportEmployeesRequest.description: importEmployeesV1: validate and plan (dry run). Writes only the import job and plan chunks. import.run (admin). Max 2000 rows.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

ApplyEmployeeImportRequest.description: applyEmployeeImportV1: processes the next unprocessed chunk (<= 100 rows) of a planned job; call repeatedly until done. Resumable and idempotent. import.run.

GetEmployeeImportRequest.description: getEmployeeImportV1: job summary and error-report data. import.run.

SubmitChallengeRequest.description: submitChallengeV1: the caller's own submission {challengeId}_{uid} for the open weekly theme. Retries with the same content are idempotent; the caller is derived from Auth, never from the payload.

outcome.description: unchanged = an idempotent replay of identical content.

RejectChallengeRequest.description: rejectChallengeV1: organizer sends a pending submission back with a reason.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Optional but expected from the portal: the `updatedAt` of the submission as listed. If the member changed the entry since, the command fails SUBMISSION_CHANGED.

ListChallengeSubmissionsRequest.description: listChallengeSubmissionsV1: organizer review queue for one challenge, ordered by submission ID.

SendInviteRequest.description: sendInviteV1: invite one same-company coworker to a scheduled, future event. The invite document id is '{eventId}_{toUserId}', so a person can be invited once per event; a replay with the same requestId by the same sender returns the same invite.

created.description: false when this requestId had already created the invite (idempotent retry).

RespondToInviteRequest.description: respondToInviteV1: the recipient accepts (joins through the same capacity transaction as setRsvpV1) or declines.

rsvpStatus.description: Present when the invite was accepted.

attendeeCount.description: Present when the invite was accepted.

Coworker.description: Minimal directory entry for the invite picker: display name, avatar id and team only; never email, role, points or other profile fields.

state.description: For the event in the request.

ListCoworkersRequest.description: listCoworkersV1: search same-company members by name for the invite picker. A query of at least 2 characters is required (no company-wide enumeration); excludes the caller.

truncated.description: true when more members match than were returned; refine the query.

ResendRosterInviteRequest.description: resendRosterInviteV1: records a resend for an invited roster entry and returns the shareable message. No email is sent. roster.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

ResendRosterInviteResponse.description: Resend result: the sign-in link and a ready-to-send message for the admin to copy.

BackfillRosterRequest.description: backfillRosterV1: creates missing claimed roster entries for existing members, 100 members per call (cursor), never touching existing entries. dryRun only counts. roster.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

BackfillRosterResponse.description: One chunk of the backfill. `created` is what would be created when dryRun is true. Call again with nextPageToken until done.

RosterCounts.description: Roster totals by state (first page only).

ListRosterRequest.description: listRosterV1: roster page with server-side state filter and search; scans in document-id order with a cursor. roster.manage.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of name, email, department, job title or work location.

ListRosterResponse.description: A page of roster entries; keep following nextPageToken (a page can be short when filters match few of the scanned entries).

GetCompanyInsightsRequest.description: getCompanyInsightsV1: how the company uses DIP. insights.read (organizer, admin); points and member balances are admin only. Read-only, no requestId.

refresh.description: Ask for fresh numbers; honored at most once a minute, otherwise the cached summary (max 10 minutes old) is returned.

pendingReviews.description: Submissions waiting for review in this theme.

invited.description: Roster entries that have not signed in yet.

activeLast30Days.description: Distinct members with an RSVP in the window (a lower bound when activeCapped).

thisMonth.description: Events starting this UTC month, any status.

attendanceRate.description: Checked in / going over the latest completed events; null without a sample.

pendingReviews.description: Waiting across the recent weekly themes.

GetCompanyInsightsResponse.description: points is present for admins only; challenges.current is absent without an active weekly theme.

generatedAt.description: When the numbers were computed (cached up to 10 minutes).

activity.description: Oldest first, the last 30 UTC days including today.
